rules.compatibility: WC or GU at the two original alignment columns; not independent structure validation
rules.original_support: exact reciprocal partners in the existing projected SS; not independent evidence
rules.no_original_support: not annotated in the original model; not evidence of absence
rules.S32: H1068 and H1074 share original S32; H1074 is not a pseudoknot
rules.extraction: Whole unpaired blocks between fixed template flanks in original columns; not guaranteed identical biological loop boundaries in every taxon.
rules.compact_view: Non-target gaps hidden only for display; target gaps kept visible, pair-column identities fixed.
